falsifiable_hypothesis: The active raw B gain vector is estimated targetwise but already has a fitting-only jackknife reliability r_g in [0,1]. The common-gain shrink can therefore be interpreted as pooling against two fixed anchors plus one fractional unit of target-specific evidence. Using s=1/(2+mean_j r_g,j) yields stronger common shrink when target gains are collectively uncertain and weaker shrink when they are reliable, with no tunable scale.
gain_rule: Reproduce signal_energy_weighted_median_theta through raw/fallback B gain g_raw, prior gain g0, target gain reliability r_g and use_raw. If use_raw is false, preserve the existing fallback gain exactly. If use_raw is true, define delta_j=g_raw,j-g0,j and mu_g=sum_j r_g,j*delta_j/sum_j r_g,j, with mu_g=0 only if all target reliabilities are zero. Set g_common,j=clip(g0,j+mu_g,[0.875,3]). Let rbar=(1/24)sum_j r_g,j and s=1/(2+rbar). Deploy gB=(1-s)g_raw+s*g_common. Thus s is automatically bounded in [1/3,1/2] and is determined only from fitting data.
theta_rule: Reproduce signal_energy_weighted_median_theta exactly after constructing deployed gB. Compute theta bias reliability r_theta; A uses the frozen [-0.9375,+0.5] gain policy and thetaA=theta_full+(1+r_theta)*bias. For B form correction-energy weights w_j=gB_j^2*theta_full,j^2*r_theta,j, take their tuning-free weighted median of theta bias as mu_B, and deploy thetaB=theta_full+bias+mu_B+r_theta*(bias-mu_B).
strength_rationale: The denominator contains two fixed pooling anchors plus the mean fitting-only reliability as an effective fractional unit of target-specific evidence. No strength menu, outer-held routing, target routing, rescue rule or post-result clipping exists in canonical replay.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across separately costed A/B orientations; never average predictions
